newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares end firmer, boosted by Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares end firmer, boosted by Wall Street.

text.p: Italian stocks ended firmer just off session highs on Tuesday on a technical rebound due to Wall Street's firmer opening following its record high close on Monday. Strong bond futures and lira were also underpinning sentiment, traders said.
Traded volume was seen higher than in recent sessions.
The all-share Mibtel index closed up 1.38 percent at 9,938 and the Mib30 blue chip index ended 1.61 percent firmer at 14,996.
Financial holding company Gemina gained 5.32 percent to 740.7 lire with sentiment continuing positive after a meeting with analysts yesterday, traders said.
Fiat, buffeted in recent sessions due to worries over Italy's depressed car market, ended 0.86 percent up at 3,998 lire after hitting a year's low on Monday at 3,920.
Energy giant Eni, ahead of a second tranche share sale later this month, was up 1.87 percent at 7,508, continuing to benefit from higher oil prices.
Telecoms were all firmer, but troubled hi-tech group Olivetti lost 1.71 percent to 482.5 lire.
